user.title: Welcome to SlotSentry
user.description:
SlotSentry gives you a single place to manage PIN codes across all your Z-Wave locks.

This wizard will discover your locks, configure code lengths, and optionally set up a keypad lockout trigger.

Secure Mode can be enabled later via Reconfigure.

locks.title: Select Z-Wave Locks
locks.description: Select all locks you want SlotSentry to manage. The number of available slots will be determined by the lock with the smallest capacity.

code_length.title: Code Length Configuration
code_length.description: Configure the PIN code length(s) for your locks. If your locks accept different PIN lengths, enable two code lengths.

lockout.title: Keypad Lockout — Optional
lockout.description: SlotSentry can automatically disable lock keypads on selected locks when a lockout trigger entity reaches a target state.

data.lockout_target_state: Target state (lockout active when entity equals this)

confirm.title: Review & Confirm
confirm.description: Review your configuration before finishing. After setup, open the SlotSentry panel from the sidebar to begin entering codes.

abort.no_zwave_locks: No Z-Wave lock entities found. Ensure Z-Wave JS is configured and locks are paired.

error.no_locks_selected: At least one lock must be selected.
error.short_gte_long: Short code length must be less than long code length.
error.no_lockout_locks: At least one lock must participate in lockout.
